detail.longDescription: Export controls are a planning input now, not a compliance checkpoint. The 11/16 US rule on remote access to advanced chips limits where compute sits — not how much reasoning you get per unit of silicon. 出口管制管的是算力放在哪里；架构效率管的是同一块硬件能榨出多少推理。前者卡采购，后者动产出效率。 Source: https://www. reuters.com/legal/litigation/u s-issues-rule-protect-advanced-ai-chips-being-accessed-remotely-2026-11-16/ # AI # MachineLearning # TechPolicy
